subject: reasoning
question: P walks 40 km towards north. He turns right and walks 80 km. He again turns right and walks 40 km. How far (in km) and in which direction is he now from the starting point?
solution:
​Given,:

P walks 40 km towards north. He turns right and walks 80 km. He again turns right and walks 40 km.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9720d6ca5d4c8c6beb264c1639b760924c638a3a31f5dc31d5358ac7764c9207.png] 

 

Thus, he is 80 km away from the starting point in the East direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
